text.p: Environmental Tectonics Corp said Friday that it has concluded a recapitalization arrangement with the First Union National Bank of Philadelphia and Tandem Capital Corp, a subsidiary of Sirrom Capital Corp.

The transaction includes a revolving senior line of credit of $10 million provided by First Union, and $4.0 million of 12 percent subordinated debentures with warrants and $2.5 million of convertible preferred stock provided by Tandem.
The company said the new capital will enabled it to refinance its existing debt at more attractive terms, and provide funding for growth.
ETC designs, manufactures, and installs aircrew training systems, sterilizer equipment, hyperbaric systems, environmental testing and simulation systems, and related products.
